title: Abhidhamma Depth Map
analytical_boundary: This is a non-destructive recommendation layer. It does not approve, reject, reorder, retitle, or rewrite any film and does not import outside Buddhist knowledge.

methodology.lens: After the relevant episodes, what can the viewer understand that they could not understand before?

levels.experience: The viewer feels or notices the teaching through an event, image, or situation.
levels.understanding: The viewer can state a distinction or causal mechanism in simple terms.
levels.structure: The viewer can place that mechanism inside a larger Abhidhamma system and recall it later.

status_definitions.missing: The current slate provides no meaningful encounter with the concept or mechanism.
status_definitions.surface_only: The idea is present mainly as image, theme, label, or analogy; a viewer is unlikely to reconstruct the mechanism.
status_definitions.introduced: The sequence gives the viewer a legible first definition or distinction, but does not yet develop it cumulatively.
status_definitions.built: More than one step, contrast, or application actively develops viewer understanding.
status_definitions.integrated: The teaching is built and then connected to earlier or later systems so it participates in a larger Abhidhamma mental model.
status_definitions.dangerously_compressed: The current narrative space carries more doctrinal structure than a viewer can reasonably make legible from the sequence.

rules: Concept linkage alone never counts as depth.
Repeated analogies without a new distinction do not count as cumulative development.
Built requires a visible progression, contrast, or later application.
Integrated requires connection to an earlier or later mechanism.
Dangerously compressed is used when narrative space is carrying an advanced process or broad taxonomy without enough steps for reconstruction.

summary.verdict_text: The slate is not merely surface-level: it genuinely builds several core mechanisms, especially mind-state composition, cognitive process, and matter. It does not yet teach the deeper architecture evenly. Broad taxonomies and the late dependent-origination, Paṭṭhāna, vipassanā, path/fruition, and plane structures are too compressed to count as fully taught.

recommendations.text: Review dependent origination and Paṭṭhāna by asking what distinct causal relation each film makes stateable, not merely felt.
Separate what is intentionally introduced from what the slate claims to build across insight, purification, jhāna, path, fruition, direct knowledge, cessation, and Nibbāna.
Preserve the strong no-traveller/not-fate spine while checking every one-film kamma, plane, death, and rebirth classification.
Test whether root-at-birth person types and the defilement compendium are understandable or only named.
Preserve the sensory-door to object to determination to javana progression as the series benchmark.
Preserve the repeated contrasts that build wanting, resistance, beautiful factors, and matter over several episodes.
Protect explicit recalls from feeling to contact, from cognitive process to death process, and from earlier groups into dependent origination.

concepts.title: Abhidhamma: conventional names and ultimate realities

linked_episodes.title: One Mountain, Many Names
linked_episodes.lesson_in_simple_terms: People can call the same mountain by many different names, and each name is useful to the people who use it. But a name is something we agree on; underneath all the names, every climber meets the same cold, wind and light.

linked_episodes.title: When Morning Begins
linked_episodes.lesson_in_simple_terms: 'Morning' is not a thing you can point to. It is a shared agreement, based on the movement of the sun, that people use to organise their lives, so the baker, the fisher, the drummer and the farmer can each have a morning that starts at a different hour.

linked_episodes.title: The Same Boat
linked_episodes.lesson_in_simple_terms: A boat can keep its name even when every plank has been replaced, because the name belongs to the way the parts are put together and to the shared story, not to any one piece of wood. Take the boat apart and you find planks, not 'a boat'.

linked_episodes.title: The Ring of Fire
linked_episodes.lesson_in_simple_terms: When a torch is whirled fast in the dark, people see a ring of fire, but there is only one moving flame. The texts use this picture for how named things can seem whole, and describe the mind itself as a fast stream of moments that feels like one.

linked_episodes.lesson_in_simple_terms: Long ago, teachers drew up a detailed map of the mind that sorts every kind of passing moment of awareness into 121 types, and young novices still learn it by heart before they understand it. concepts.title: The two hate-rooted types of consciousness

linked_episodes.title: The Mended Net
linked_episodes.lesson_in_simple_terms: Anger often starts as wanting: we want something, something gets in the way, and the wanting turns against whatever blocked it. The texts say this state always comes with pain, and the first person it hurts is the one who feels it.

linked_episodes.title: The Watch Hut
linked_episodes.lesson_in_simple_terms: Fear and anger are closer than they look: both are the mind saying 'no' to something it does not want. The texts describe anger as pushing against a threat, and fear as the same pushing-away once the threat seems too strong to face.

linked_episodes.title: Held Up
linked_episodes.lesson_in_simple_terms: Even a small, ordinary refusal, like a bus that will not move, can set off displeasure, and each person feels it inside before anyone else sees it. The texts name 'not getting what one wants' as one of the most common times this happens.

linked_episodes.title: What the Body Remembers
linked_episodes.lesson_in_simple_terms: Anger never comes with real delight, even when it feels deserved. The texts describe it as burning the person who holds it, and advise living watchfully because it visits ordinary people so often.

concepts.title: The two delusion-rooted minds: doubt and restlessness

linked_episodes.title: Which Way
linked_episodes.lesson_in_simple_terms: Not knowing which way to go is not a failing in itself. But when the mind cannot settle on anything, the texts say it feels neither good nor bad, just flat and stalled.

linked_episodes.title: The Drowned Town
linked_episodes.lesson_in_simple_terms: Something you cannot see is not necessarily gone. The texts describe some states of mind as lying hidden, like a town under water, and rising again when conditions change.

linked_episodes.title: Four O'Clock Prices
linked_episodes.lesson_in_simple_terms: When everything arrives at once, attention scatters. The texts compare this restlessness to water ruffled by the wind, and name rushing and doing many things at once as moments when it tends to arise.

linked_episodes.title: Among the Roots
linked_episodes.lesson_in_simple_terms: What keeps us stuck is not always what started it. The texts call greed, hatred and confusion 'roots' because they hold the mind in place the way roots hold a tree up, and they name good roots too: letting go, goodwill and understanding.

linked_episodes.title: The Almsgiving
linked_episodes.lesson_in_simple_terms: People doing the same work go about it in very different ways. The texts say everyone has every leaning, with each person tilting a little one way, and that each troublesome leaning sits close to a good one.

linked_episodes.title: Slow Through the Mist
linked_episodes.lesson_in_simple_terms: When you cannot see far, the way through is to slow down and look carefully at what is right in front of you. The texts describe confusion as something that darkens the mind, and name calm as the opposite of restlessness.

mechanisms.name: Death process and rebirth-linking
mechanisms.summary: Frames dying and a new beginning as causally connected processes with no entity travelling between lives.
mechanisms.viewer_understanding_summary: The viewer can understand continuity without a traveller: the last process conditions a new beginning that is neither the same life nor unrelated to it.
compression_risks: The no-traveller principle is repeated well, while the exact death and rebirth-linking classifications are compressed into individual films.
mechanisms.notes: Derived only from the repository's concept roles, episode/group lessons, loglines, and chronology; not an external doctrinal correction.

mechanisms.name: Planes of existence
mechanisms.summary: Maps sense, fine-material, immaterial, and supramundane ranges and the kinds of mind available in them.
mechanisms.viewer_understanding_summary: The viewer can understand that the source system posits different planes with different available modes of mind, but not how the full cosmological and citta maps correspond.
compression_risks: Several plane and rebirth-linking classifications are each carried by one episode, while their relation to jhāna arrives much later and under heavy load.
mechanisms.notes: Derived only from the repository's concept roles, episode/group lessons, loglines, and chronology; not an external doctrinal correction.

mechanisms.name: Dependent origination
mechanisms.summary: Re-reads earlier groups as a conditioned chain from ignorance through contact, feeling, craving, becoming, birth, ageing, and death.
mechanisms.viewer_understanding_summary: The viewer can recognise 'because of this, that' and connect several earlier experiences, but is unlikely to reconstruct the twelve links, periods, connections, rounds, and roots from the present sequence.
compression_risks: The mechanism is asked to integrate eight prior groups in only a few films, and C080's link meanings are concentrated in one episode.
mechanisms.notes: Derived only from the repository's concept roles, episode/group lessons, loglines, and chronology; not an external doctrinal correction.

mechanisms.name: Conditions / Paṭṭhāna
mechanisms.summary: Distinguishes multiple ways one event can support another, rather than treating all causation as one simple chain.
mechanisms.viewer_understanding_summary: The viewer may understand that causes work in different ways and that mutual and external supports matter, but the twenty-four-condition logic is not yet reconstructable.
compression_risks: Agricultural and structural analogies multiply, yet the current sequence does not differentiate enough of the twenty-four conditions to justify calling the system taught.
mechanisms.notes: Derived only from the repository's concept roles, episode/group lessons, loglines, and chronology; not an external doctrinal correction.

mechanisms.name: Samatha
mechanisms.summary: Presents calm as trained stabilisation through suitable meditation subjects, recollections, sublime abidings, and absorption.
mechanisms.viewer_understanding_summary: The viewer can understand that calm practice has different objects suited to different people and that steadiness supports clearer seeing.
compression_risks: Practices are distributed across four groups, but their shared samatha architecture is not explicitly consolidated before the rapid Group 10 ascent.
mechanisms.notes: Derived only from the repository's concept roles, episode/group lessons, loglines, and chronology; not an external doctrinal correction.

mechanisms.name: Vipassanā
mechanisms.summary: Moves from direct contemplation of mind and matter toward insight, purification, and release.
mechanisms.viewer_understanding_summary: The viewer can understand that insight examines conditioned mind and matter and depends on conduct and steadiness, but cannot yet follow the insight knowledges or seven-purification progression.
compression_risks: The central liberating method receives two explicit Group 10 films while large maps of insight and purification are carried almost entirely by one of them.
mechanisms.notes: Derived only from the repository's concept roles, episode/group lessons, loglines, and chronology; not an external doctrinal correction.

mechanisms.name: Jhāna
mechanisms.summary: Builds absorption as sustained attention that simplifies through mastered levels and conditions later capacities.
mechanisms.viewer_understanding_summary: The viewer can understand absorption as trained, sustained, progressively simplified attention rather than a mystical mood.
compression_risks: The experiential progression works, but fine-material and immaterial citta classifications, factors, and processes are stacked into very few films.
mechanisms.notes: Derived only from the repository's concept roles, episode/group lessons, loglines, and chronology; not an external doctrinal correction.

mechanisms.name: Path and fruition
mechanisms.summary: Distinguishes the path moment that uproots from fruition and from temporary suppression, across stages of noble personhood.
mechanisms.viewer_understanding_summary: The viewer can distinguish letting go from standing in the result and suppression from uprooting, but is unlikely to understand the full path/fruition process and four-stage architecture.
compression_risks: Several advanced maps converge in six films immediately before Nibbāna, with C100's process confined to one episode.
mechanisms.notes: Derived only from the repository's concept roles, episode/group lessons, loglines, and chronology; not an external doctrinal correction.

mechanisms.name: Nibbāna
mechanisms.summary: Completes the opening map with the unconditioned fourth ultimate, described as neither a feeling nor a place nor something constructed.
mechanisms.viewer_understanding_summary: The viewer can understand Nibbāna as unconditioned and uncovered rather than manufactured, and can recognise it as the delayed completion of Group 1's map.
compression_risks: The bookend is strong, but the path/fruition and insight architecture immediately before it is compressed enough to weaken how the viewer understands the arrival.

groups.title: The Names of Things
strong_areas: Conventional vs ultimate reality is developed through names, time, parts, absence, perception, and personhood.
The four-ultimate map gives the full slate a clear opening promise.
weak_or_compressed_areas: The 121-citta map is announced faster than a viewer can organise it.
The all-things compendium bundles aggregates, bases, elements, and truths without a progressive internal map.
groups.what_a_viewer_likely_learns: The viewer can separate a name from what is present and begin to see experience as passing mind-and-matter events rather than one solid person or thing.
groups.internal_progression_assessment: The internal sequence contains real cumulative steps, with some subtopics remaining introductory.
groups.handoff_assessment: If names sit on top of passing moments, what in those moments makes us hold on? The group ends as the lantern comes down and leaves the next group to ask where wanting begins: in the pleasant feelings of the sense world, and in the kinds of mind rooted in greed.
risks: C018 and C077 carry large catalogues inside an otherwise lucid experiential arc.
groups.recommendation_summary: Preserve the name/thing progression; review whether the map episode promises more classification knowledge than later films actually recall.

groups.title: Wanting
strong_areas: Wanting is differentiated by feeling tone, prompting, view, aim, effort, and desire-to-act.
Repeated ordinary situations make distinctions cumulative rather than merely symbolic.
weak_or_compressed_areas: The complete 54 sense-sphere classification remains background rather than a viewer-held structure.
groups.what_a_viewer_likely_learns: The viewer can understand that pleasant or neutral feeling can condition wanting, and that the wish to act is not automatically greed.
groups.internal_progression_assessment: The internal sequence contains real cumulative steps, with some subtopics remaining introductory.
groups.handoff_assessment: If wanting itself never comes with displeasure, what is the heat that arrives when it is refused, lost or outbid? Group 3 takes up anger and fear, which the texts describe as always arising with displeasure and felt first by the one who is angry.
risks: Do not let the strong greed sequence imply that every desire-to-act is ethically unwholesome.
groups.recommendation_summary: Likely adequate; preserve the contrasts and the bridge from feeling to later contact/process teaching.

groups.title: Anger and Fear
strong_areas: Anger, fear, stinginess, wrong view, conceit, prompting, and dullness are progressively differentiated.
The sequence makes aversion's immediate suffering legible.
weak_or_compressed_areas: The full factor make-up of all twelve unwholesome minds is not reconstructable from the final two films.
groups.what_a_viewer_likely_learns: The viewer can understand resistance as a family of differently composed states, always painful at the hate-rooted core.
groups.internal_progression_assessment: The internal sequence contains real cumulative steps, with some subtopics remaining introductory.
groups.handoff_assessment: Having found delusion and restlessness underneath every flare of heat, and ending in a household that cannot settle, the group hands on the question of what it is that stops us seeing clearly once the heat has gone and only confusion remains.
risks: C028 risks implying completion of a matrix that the films only sample.
groups.recommendation_summary: Likely adequate at mechanism level; label the exact twelve-mind matrix as compressed during review.

groups.title: Lost
strong_areas: Doubt and restlessness become experientially distinct.
The six roots and temperament idea prepare a non-fixed account of why people struggle differently.
weak_or_compressed_areas: The defilement compendium's taints, floods, bonds, clingings, hindrances, tendencies, and fetters remain mostly vocabulary.
Root-at-birth person types receive one film and carry sensitive doctrinal implications.
groups.what_a_viewer_likely_learns: The viewer can recognise confusion as unsettled mind and see that harmful patterns can lie latent and recur under conditions.
groups.internal_progression_assessment: The experiential spine is legible, but several classifications change the topic faster than understanding accumulates.
groups.handoff_assessment: Having slowed down in the fog, it leaves the question: what do we actually find when we look closely at a single moment of seeing?
risks: The group changes from lived confusion to several classification systems faster than it integrates them.
groups.recommendation_summary: Needs review: retain the doubt/restlessness arc, but test whether C049 and C074 are understandable rather than merely named.

groups.title: Slowing Down
strong_areas: Doors, objects, intensity, turning, mind-door recall, universal factors, full process, and javana form a real progressive sequence.
The group converts an everyday claim such as 'I see' into an ordered mechanism.
weak_or_compressed_areas: Special cases for great, slight, and very slight objects and the exact rootless-factor matrix receive single-film treatment.
groups.what_a_viewer_likely_learns: The viewer can understand that seeing is a conditioned sequence, that names and values arrive after bare sensory contact, and that response occurs within the process without a controller outside it.
groups.internal_progression_assessment: The internal sequence builds a mechanism and connects it to wider teaching.
groups.handoff_assessment: If good or harm takes shape at the moment of response (the series' 'gap in which we can choose goodness'), what is a good response actually made of? GRP-06 (Kindness) takes that up: the many beautiful factors that arise together in a good mind, and how kindness becomes a practice.

strongest_mechanisms.name: Six doors, objects, bases, and functions

risks: The core is strong enough that peripheral classifications may look equally taught even when they are not.
groups.recommendation_summary: Strong cumulative teaching; preserve this group's ordering and use it as the benchmark for later mechanism-building.

groups.title: Kindness
strong_areas: Beautiful factors are shown as a team through refusal, joy, softness, calm, compassion, and balance.
Compassion and sympathetic joy are distinguished rather than blended.
weak_or_compressed_areas: Eight wholesome/resultant mind classifications and complete factor matrices are compressed.
groups.what_a_viewer_likely_learns: The viewer can understand goodness as a differently composed mind with lightness, flexibility, restraint, and care, not just as a moral label.
groups.internal_progression_assessment: The internal sequence contains real cumulative steps, with some subtopics remaining introductory.
groups.handoff_assessment: Caring for others has led to bodies that tire, sicken and age, so the next stage asks what the body itself is made of and why decay is written into it.
risks: Kamma-result language begins here but is not fully explained until Group 8.
groups.recommendation_summary: Likely adequate; preserve the factor-team logic and explicitly hand its result question to Group 8.

groups.title: The Body
strong_areas: Matter, elements, origins, life-stream, decay, death, body contemplation, and breathing make a coherent vulnerability arc.
The four origins are applied to concrete bodily functions rather than merely listed.
weak_or_compressed_areas: The five objects, matter classifications, origin-by-kind mapping, and material-group taxonomy each receive limited support.
groups.what_a_viewer_likely_learns: The viewer can understand the body as a continuously conditioned material process, always grouped, supported, changing, and already decaying.
groups.internal_progression_assessment: The internal sequence contains real cumulative steps, with some subtopics remaining introductory.
groups.handoff_assessment: If a body stops in layers and nothing in it goes on being renewed, what, if anything, continues, and how is the end of one life linked to what follows?

strongest_mechanisms.name: Six doors, objects, bases, and functions
Material groups and origins of matter

risks: Several one-film classifications sit inside a very strong experiential body story and can be mistaken for full coverage.
groups.recommendation_summary: Preserve the arc; review single-appearance material taxonomies and the bridge from material cessation to Group 8's mental continuity.

groups.title: Endings
strong_areas: Continuity without a traveller, timing of results, opposed action, intention, bedside conditions, and death recollection form a meaningful sequence.
The group repeatedly resists fatalism.
weak_or_compressed_areas: Planes, rebirth-linking types, kamma functions and priority, causes of death, and near-death process are often one-film classifications.
groups.what_a_viewer_likely_learns: The viewer can understand kamma as intention and conditioned result, and rebirth as causal continuity rather than a person moving between lives.
groups.internal_progression_assessment: The internal sequence contains real cumulative steps, with some subtopics remaining introductory.
groups.handoff_assessment: If nothing passes across and yet everything continues, what connects it all? The next group follows that thread as conditions: how each thing arises only with the support of others, and so can also come to an end.
risks: Fourteen concepts compete inside twelve films; the central mechanism is built, but many taxonomies are not.
groups.recommendation_summary: Needs careful review: preserve the no-traveller and not-fate spine, and mark the surrounding classifications as introductions unless later films recall them.

groups.title: Nothing Stands Alone
strong_areas: The group attempts the right structural move: earlier groups become one conditioned story.
Short/long causal accounts, mutual support, external support, and cessation introduce different causal shapes.
weak_or_compressed_areas: The twelve-link meanings and structural analysis are concentrated in very few films.
Twenty-four conditions are represented mainly through analogies and are not individually or systematically differentiable.
groups.what_a_viewer_likely_learns: The viewer can understand that nothing stands alone and that removing support changes what can continue, but cannot yet reconstruct dependent origination or Paṭṭhāna as systems.
groups.internal_progression_assessment: The group carries too many advanced structures for its current film count, even where the emotional arc is coherent.
groups.handoff_assessment: If the wheel turns on two roots, not-seeing and craving, and Margaya says there is no other way out of it than removing them, then what arises by conditions can end by conditions, and the next group asks what that way through actually involves.
risks: The group can feel profound while leaving the mechanism below the understanding level.
C075 adds another large compendium to an eight-film group.
groups.recommendation_summary: Highest-priority mechanism review: test every episode against what causal distinction the viewer can state afterwards.

groups.title: The Way Through
strong_areas: Calm, insight, jhāna, suppression, uprooting, path, fruition, cessation, and Nibbāna are given a deliberate ascent.
Nibbāna completes Group 1's four-ultimate map and is protected from being framed as a feeling or place.
weak_or_compressed_areas: Twenty concepts in twelve films create the slate's highest concept density.
Insight, purifications, requisites, supramundane classifications, path process, direct knowledge, and cessation each need more than a single narrative touch to become mechanisms.
groups.what_a_viewer_likely_learns: The viewer can understand that training progresses from steadiness toward insight and irreversible change, and that Nibbāna is unconditioned; the viewer is unlikely to grasp the full route architecture.
groups.internal_progression_assessment: The group carries too many advanced structures for its current film count, even where the emotional arc is coherent.
groups.handoff_assessment: It hands directly to Episode 100, "The Way Back": the last film ends in the crowd that opens Episode 1, and the finale follows Chathura back along the road to the forest, leaving open on screen the question this group raised, what it would take to walk the way through.
risks: A compelling emotional culmination may mask doctrinal compression.
Path/fruition and vipassanā are not built to the same depth as the Group 5 cognitive process.
groups.recommendation_summary: Highest-priority chronology review: preserve the ascent and final bookend, but identify which advanced maps are intentionally introduced versus truly taught.
